scope: historical read first; bounded fresh V13 economics without politics, no guild implementation
start: newMerchantGame Ulf Luebeck,5000 cash,one Kogge,empty cargo,zero debt except declared aggressive1500 loan
pilot: normal10001 actual baseline plus one exact reproduction; if incompatible stop before remaining runs
baseline: remaining9 unique cases;10 distinct cases total,11 executions including pilot repeat
feeSelectionAfterBaselineOnly: reference=25th percentile of observed debt-buffered free cash at first post-sale checkpoint reaching day30 per distinct baseline; candidates=10%,25%,50% reference rounded down to100,positive unique values
feeContinuation: all5 strategies,seed10001,each of at most3 selected fees;at most15 new paths
reserveProxy: cheapest available10-unit basket+two own ship fees+80 one future storm repair+all remaining debt+short-cycle debt interest+committed rental costs; never guarantees profit or sustained solvency
information: planners isolated from game VM;only current local quotes/stocks,own journal and actual known route times;no remote live prices or future RNG
stop: no affordable travel, invalid native action,120-day limit or60 decision cycles; no forced horizon overshoot
